snippet.title: Covenant Tower Trailer
snippet.description:
The Covenant Tower is an incremental tower defense game where you build your tower higher during the day, defend it with archers and catapults at night, and prevent world-ending catastrophes by fulfilling an ancient prophecy. Strategic. Satisfying. Surprisingly addictive..
